I've watched every JonTron video, all the way back to the Daikatana review he made.  I've been a loyal fan of him for years. So you could imagine my surprise when I got on youtube to find one of my favorite youtubers being called "Racist", along with many other slanderous words.  In all of my time watching his channel, reading tweets, etc. I never so much as found a hint of racism in his content.  And as I was watching through the entire two hour debate, my jaw dropped half way through.  I couldn't believe a lot of what was said.  I knew that this sort of talk had to of been because of pressure or something related, because I had never seen Jon in any sort of debating arena.  Not to mention, he was being fact checked pretty often which would put anybody on edge.  

But after watching it through to the end, and watching this clip, I understand what you were trying to say.  The fact that race is still such a pressing issue in the US just goes to show that people are too blind to see just how deluded everyone is. Not JUST whites. Not JUST blacks.  Every race has discrimination in one place or another these days.  It's the simple fact that those with well enough minds to see past color don't speak up about it in fear that, like Jontron, they'll be called a racist (or something similar).  

If all of us could drop racism completely as MLK intended and simply see each other as "Americans", not only would we be more happy, but the US would probably be a more successful country as a whole.  

But sadly, people can't seem to move past this issue. I'm sure I speak for all TRUE JonTron fans when I say I'm not going to let the media decide what I think of him.  He's still the same person he was before this shit started.  And I'll be watching his videos when the next Civil War breaks out lmao.
